source.title: Rethink the Role of Neural Decoders in Quantum Error Correction
source.source_reported_result: A distance-9 TCN configuration is reported at 271 cycles (~0.77 microseconds at 350 MHz) from Vitis HLS synthesis for a Versal VP1902 in the paper's incremental streaming setup.
